name: Family Sex ~Kazoku Rankou Nikki~
original_name: ファミリーセックス～家族乱交日記～
source:
Misa lost her parents in an accident and was taken to the family of her uncle. Her wounds only start to heal when uncle comes home drunk and mistakes her body for someone else's. Misa forgives her uncle, and a different life begins from now on.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/11/vn-of-month-november-2005-sharin-no.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
米莎在一次事故中失去了父母，被带到叔叔家。当叔叔醉酒回家并误认为她的身体是别人的身体时，她的伤口才开始愈合。米莎原谅了叔叔，从此开始了不一样的生活。
